$comment: The CLI<->server authentication contract, pinned.
A token is only usable if the CLI asks Auth0 for the SAME tenant and audience
the server validates against. Nothing used to check that, and the two drifted:
cli <=0.2.9 requested prod tokens from the DEV tenant (dev-46tiys6hnb6vbg17,
audience chat.divinci.app:8081) while prod validates divinci-prod /
chat.divinci.app:8080. Every /api/v1 call 403'd, re-logging in never helped,
and the server's fail-open made a valid token, a garbage token and no token
at all indistinguishable. Fixed in a68180cdd3, shipped in 0.2.10.
`audience` and `issuer` MUST equal the server's AUTH0_AUDIENCE and
AUTH0_BASE_URL for that environment (Infisical, path /). Changing a value
here without changing it there re-creates the outage, so this file is a lock:
tests/unit/auth/auth0-contract.test.ts fails if src/auth/oauth.ts drifts from
it, and scripts/verify-auth0-contract.mjs checks it against Infisical where
credentials exist.
Verified against Infisical on 2026-08-12: prod, staging and dev all AGREE.
DEV's audience is the literal string 'http://localhost:8081'. That looks
like a local value that leaked into a deployed environment, and on
2026-08-12 it was read that way and nearly 'fixed' on the SERVER side. That
would have been wrong and would have broken things. The evidence:
* Infisical dev AUTH0_AUDIENCE = http://localhost:8081 (what the server
validates)
* workspace/clients/playwright/.auth/user.json holds a REAL dev-tenant
token whose aud includes 'http://localhost:8081', issued by
dev-46tiys6hnb6vbg17 -- so it is a registered API in that tenant and is
what the dev web client and the E2E suite actually receive
Server, tenant and web client agreed; only the CLI asked for something else
('chat.divinci.app:8081'), which is the value that was wrong.
Lesson worth keeping: a config value that LOOKS wrong is not evidence that
it is wrong. Check what the tenant actually issues before changing the side
that happens to be easier to reach.
!! deploy/config.json is NOT a source of truth for any of this. It lists
prod as divinci.us.auth0.com / 'https://api.divinci.app' and develop as
divinci-staging.us.auth0.com; Infisical says divinci-prod.us.auth0.com /
'chat.divinci.app:8080' and dev-46tiys6hnb6vbg17 respectively. It is a
stale document. Verify against Infisical and the tenant, never that file.
!! SEPARATE, STILL OPEN: the dev Auth0 application does not have the CLI's
callback ports registered. `divinci auth login` against dev fails with
'unauthorized_client: Callback URL mismatch' before audience validation
is even reached. Add http://localhost:8666/8667/8668 to that
application's Allowed Callback URLs in the Auth0 dashboard.
